license_note: The official model card and docs page declare North Mini Code released under Apache 2.0 and suitable for local deployment, with no acceptable-use addendum or noncommercial cap, unlike the CC-BY-NC Command lines. No LICENSE file ships in the weight repository, so the grant rests on those concordant first-party declarations pointing at the standard Apache-2.0 text.

license_evidence.scope: North Mini Code weights as declared on the official model card and docs page, pointing at the standard Apache-2.0 text

access_boundary: This record represents the June 2026 North-Mini-Code-1.0 release, the inaugural member of Cohere's North family of code models, together with its Chat API and Model Vault serving. The North enterprise platform, later North family members, and downstream quantizations and fine-tunes remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated 30B MoE coding weights under a declared Apache-2.0 grant
First-party Chat API and Model Vault production serving for the exact model ID
tradeoffs: No LICENSE file ships beside the weights; the grant rests on card and docs declarations
A three-month-old line with no retirement posture yet
